subject: Pilot runway augmentation & one-time credit grant request - Ledgerix
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runway augmentation & credit ask — Ledgerix

Team,

Quick ask: Ledgerix (prospect) is stuck mid-integration and needs additional runway + one-time credits to finish their feature validation. Short summary: they ran a large internal integration test last week and chewed through the PLG allotment. They are committed — product team forwarded logs and we can see the usage spike during their end-to-end test.

Why this matters
- Strategic fit: ledger reconciliation + Redwood embeddings search; potential logo and reference.
- Timing: they want a final validation run the week of 4/8; closing expected in Q2 if the run completes successfully.

Requested non-standard terms
- Pilot extension: add 60 days to the standard PLG window (current trial ends 2028-03-31).
- One-time credits: 50k token-equivalent credit (covers expected run + buffer).

Attachments: ledgerix_usage_snapshot_Q1_2028.csv, ledgerix_mvp_milestones_v2.pdf, Ledgerix_SOW-draft.docx

Metrics (from usage snapshot)
- Current consumption: 1.1M tokens used during trial (last 7 days spike).
- Estimated incremental tokens to complete E2E validation: ~700k.

Plan if approved
1) Apply one-time credits that auto-apply to trial usage (expires 90 days after grant).
2) Condition approval on signing the SOW and a 30-min validation review within 7 days after the run.
3) Require CSM (Marissa) to own success metrics and formal handoff to renewals.

I need an exec decision on the credits because this exceeds the Deal Desk guideline for PLG one-off credits (> $25k equivalent). Ben: can you flag risk and suggested caps? Marissa: please confirm the success criteria. Laura: would you sign off on an exception here?

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway augmentation & credit ask — Ledgerix

Jonas — thanks for the heads up. Quick notes inline: 

- I pulled the usage stubs and also attached the draft SOW with a milestone that ties to the validation run.
- Proposed success metric: 3 representative reconciliation flows completed with <2% false positives and end-to-end latency <600ms on their target sequence lengths. If they meet this, we move to a commercial pilot discussion within 30 days.
- My ask: can we reduce the credit ask to 30k tokens and still offer the 60-day extension? That puts less upside risk on the company and is likely still sufficient to complete the run.

Attachments: Ledgerix_SOW-draft.docx

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway augmentation & credit ask — Ledgerix

Agree with Marissa on conditioning the grant on the SOW milestones. Per Deal Desk policy: any one-time credit > $25k equivalent needs leadership approval. Two options to surface to Laura:

1) Approve a 60-day extension + one-time 30k credit (lower risk).
2) Approve 60-day extension + 50k credit with a clause that any consumption beyond 30k is subject to review and immediate billing at standard PLG rates if no milestone is hit.

Risk note: Ledgerix has a complex integration pattern (they will be embedding large ledgers) and our caching/batching profiles may not yield linear savings. Recommend approving the lower credit amount and offering committed pricing in the SOW for post-pilot usage to lock renewal economics.

Ben
Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T14:17:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot runway augmentation & credit ask — Ledgerix (exec ask)

Laura — looping you in with a short ask: can you approve an exception for Ledgerix? TL;DR: 60-day extension + one-time credit. Marissa recommends 30k; my original ask was 50k. This is a high-probability close and we expect to convert to a paid Dedicated deal if validation passes. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DLG-2028-042

Why this merits exception:
- Partner/reference potential in financial services vertical.
- Fast timeline; they will run their final validation in April and will need the run to complete to finalize procurement.
- We have product-side signals (embedding recall and latency) that the model variant will be sufficient; this is primarily runway and token budget.

If you can give a one-line approval (or conditions) I will finalize with procurement and have Marissa update the SOW. Appreciated.

— Jonas

On Fri, Mar 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick ask: Ledgerix (prospect) is stuck mid-integration and needs additional runway + one-time credits to finish their feature validation....

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, FinanceOps <financeops@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway augmentation & credit ask — Ledgerix (approved w/ conditions)

Jonas / team — OK to approve, with the following firm conditions: 

1) One-time credits capped at 30,000 token-equivalent and will be applied only to the pilot account. Any consumption beyond the 30k cap will be billed at standard PLG usage rates and will not be covered by the grant.
2) Pilot window extended by 60 days from current expiry (new expiry 2028-05-30).
3) SOW must be signed before credits are applied and must include the milestone validation language Marissa proposed.
4) CSM (Marissa) schedule a 30-minute validation review within 7 days of the final run and capture the three test flows and latency proof points.
5) Security questionnaire completion (we received initial responses; complete the outstanding items before the new expiry).
6) Credits expire 90 days after grant and cannot be rolled forward.

Ben / FinanceOps: please set a billing flag on deal DLG-2028-042 and create an allowance for the 30k token-equivalent credit. Apply the credit only after signed SOW is uploaded to the HubSpot record.

Jonas: please confirm you will (a) share the signed SOW link and (b) confirm the validation review time once the run is scheduled.

Congratulations — this should give Ledgerix the runway they need while limiting our exposure.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
